title: Neon Lanes
objective: Drive as far as possible down a synthwave highway, dodging obstacles and collecting coins.
controls: Swipe left or right to switch between three lanes, swipe up to jump over barriers, and tap on-screen buttons to revive or play.
core_loop: Swipe to switch lanes or jump over neon obstacles to collect coins and push your distance further.
progression: Speed steadily increases as distance climbs from 6m past 246m, with tighter obstacle patterns.
hook_idea: Swiping up to leap over the glowing orange barriers with the 'GREAT JUMP!' banner at t=7.8-8.8s
